register.name: Lesotho Highlands Water Project royalties
register.detail: Treaty with South Africa · Water transfers · Fiscal year 2025/26
register.note: Expected for 2025/26; M4.95 billion budgeted for 2026/27
register.text: Royalties paid by South Africa for about 780 million cubic metres of water a year transferred from the highlands. The Budget Speech of 18 February 2026 expects “exceptionally high” royalties of M4.78 billion to give 2025/26 a surplus, and budgets M4.95 billion for 2026/27. In March 2026 Lesotho called for new terms (News24).

register.name: Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation (ASCENT–Lesotho)
register.detail: Announced 27 May 2026 · IDA credit · Agreement signed, announced by the Government 19 June 2026
register.note: Electricity for nearly 147,000 residents and businesses
register.text: Extends the grid in peri-urban, rural and highland areas, with standalone solar for the last mile and pilots of off-grid power, and supports utility reform and clean cooking. Household access to electricity rose from 7% in 2004 to 59% in 2024; universal access by 2030 needs more than 45,000 connections a year, against about 4,000 a year now.

register.name: Lesotho Education Improvement Project
register.text: Builds 189 classrooms, 1,140 latrines, 48 laboratories and 10 workshops in targeted schools, and strengthens the teaching of foundational skills in the early primary grades. It also funds a national learning assessment in junior secondary school, where education sets Lesotho’s Coverage.

register.name: Competitiveness and Financial Inclusion Project
register.detail: Announced 28 June 2022 · $45 million loan · $7.5 million Global Risk Financing Facility grant
register.note: At least 500 entrepreneurs and SMEs, half of them owned by women
register.text: Gives micro, small and medium enterprises better access to business services and finance, with a focus on women and young people, and digitalises government services to business. At least 15,000 small firms are to become more resilient to climate and other shocks.

register.name: Pathways to Sustainable Livelihoods Project
register.text: Makes selected social assistance programmes more efficient and fair, and digitalises the social protection system of the Ministry of Social Development. It helps poor and vulnerable households move from support into productive work.

register.name: Nutrition and Health System Strengthening Project
register.detail: Approved 25 June 2021 · $22 million IDA credit · $4.4 million grant
register.note: Nutrition and primary care in high-stunting districts
register.text: Funds community nutrition services where stunting is highest, village health workers who track children’s growth, and quality grants to every public and Christian Health Association of Lesotho facility. It carries the National Food and Nutrition Strategy.

register.name: Renewable Energy and Energy Access Project
register.detail: Announced 30 January 2020 · $40 million IDA · $12.9 million Scaling Up Renewable Energy Program
register.text: Upgrades the hydro mini-grid at Semonkong, extends the grid to the economic zones and builds mini-grids where they are the least-cost option. It also sets the legal and regulatory frame for private mini-grids.

register.name: Lesotho Lowlands Water Development Project, Botha-Bothe region
register.detail: Approved 11 December 2019 · Signed 22 September 2020 · Total cost $108.7 million
register.text: New water delivery and treatment works, house connections and water points in the Botha-Bothe region. Co-financed with the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development, BADEA, the Kuwait Fund and the Saudi Fund for Development.

register.name: Smallholder Agriculture Development Project II
register.detail: Announced 30 May 2019 · $50 million IDA · $2 million Japan PHRD grant · Seven years, all ten districts
register.text: Matching grants for on-farm and post-harvest investment, training in climate-smart farming, and nutrition education for rural households. At least half of the farmers and agro-processors reached are to be women and young people.

register.name: Lesotho Lowlands Water Development Project, Phase II
register.detail: Announced 17 May 2019 · IDA · Parallel financing from the EIB and the European Development Fund
register.note: Water for about 115,000 people in Maputsoe and Hlotse
register.text: Brings bulk water to the lowland towns of Maputsoe and Hlotse, their industry and the villages along the pipeline. The lowlands are where most Basotho live, and safely managed drinking water reaches 31.3% of citizens.

register.name: Lesotho Tax Modernization Project, supplemental financing
register.detail: African Development Fund loan · 2021 · Original project approved November 2017
register.text: Pays for e-taxation, e-payment and e-invoicing systems and links banks and mobile money providers to the Lesotho Revenue Authority. A broader tax base, reaching small businesses and the informal sector, is revenue the nation can spend on the seven standards.

register.name: Lesotho Lowlands Water Supply Scheme
register.detail: Signed 26 April 2019 · EIB loan €82 million · EU grant €41 million
register.note: At least 300,000 direct beneficiaries, about 15% of the population
register.text: River intakes, treatment works, pipelines, a pumping station and distribution networks, with small-scale sanitation and hygiene and a cut in water losses. The EIB and the EU cover more than 60% of the cost, alongside World Bank financing.

register.name: Waiver of two Chinese interest-free loans
register.detail: Protocol signed 9 April 2026 · Loans of 2011 and 2012, due by the end of 2024
register.note: Debt relief on loans for the Manthabiseng Convention Centre and a mushroom project
register.text: China waived two interest-free loans with a combined disbursed amount of M214.466 million, under its pledge to cancel such loans due by the end of 2024 for least developed African countries. The Minister of Finance called it crucial relief for the public debt, which carries Lesotho’s spending on schools, clinics and water.

register.name: U.S.–Lesotho health cooperation memorandum of understanding
register.detail: Signed December 2025 · Five years from April 2026
register.note: Planned investment over five years (M6.18 billion)
register.text: Aims to save lives and strengthen Lesotho’s health system over five years. The Budget Speech of February 2026 puts the U.S. disbursement at US$218 million (M3.5 billion) over five years from April 2026. Lesotho has passed the 95-95-95 HIV targets, at 97-97-99.

register.name: Butha-Buthe drinking water system
register.detail: Loan agreement announced 11 November 2021 · AED 73 million
register.note: 350 km of pipelines, 25 pumping stations, 42 tanks
register.text: A barrier and intake on the Hololo River, a treatment plant and about 350 km of transmission and distribution lines for Butha-Buthe District and its industry, designed to supply the district to 2045. The Fund expects water-borne illness to fall by half.
